newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bank shares higher as Nikkei rises.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares higher as Nikkei rises.

text.p: Bank shares rose on Friday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in active trade in line with an overall rise in the bourse, traders said.
By midday, shares of Sakura Bank Ltd were up 37 yen at 770 yen in turnover was 4.80 million shares, making it the third most actively traded issue on the first section of the TSE.
Fuji Bank Ltd was up 60 yen at 1,600 yen. Its turnover was 2.65 million shares and it was the seventh most actively traded issue on the first section of the TSE.
Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd was up 40 yen at 2,340 yen in turnover of 2.16 million shares
Daiwa Bank Ltd was up 30 yen at 613 and Sumitomo Bank Ltd up 30 yen at 1,940.
"The entire market is recovering and traders are buying bank shares to balance their portfolios," an official at a large brokerage said.
